# Elora & Eluna

> Elora & Eluna are twin luxury residential towers developed by Pakuwon Group in Kota Kasablanka Phase IV, a 12.9 hectare superblock in South Jakarta, Indonesia. Eluna, inspired by the moon, is the current tower: 2 and 3 bedroom residences with resort-style facilities and direct access to Mall Kota Kasablanka. Elora, inspired by the sun, is coming soon as Phase II.

## Key facts

- Project: Elora & Eluna (Eluna Tower and Elora Tower), Kota Kasablanka Phase IV
- Location: Kota Kasablanka, Jl. Casablanca Raya Kav 88, Menteng Dalam, Tebet, South Jakarta (Jakarta Selatan), DKI Jakarta 12870, Indonesia
- Developer: Pakuwon Group (https://www.pakuwon.com/), through PT Elite Prima Hutama
- Masterplan: Kota Kasablanka spans 12.9 hectares and includes Office Tower 88, Prudential Centre, Mall Kota Kasablanka, Casa Grande Residence 1 and 2, Pakuwon Tower, Eluna Tower, Elora Tower, and W Hotels & Tribute Portfolio by Marriott
- Integrated with: W Hotels and Tribute Portfolio by Marriott, and Mall Kota Kasablanka (operating since 2012)
- Unit types: 2 bedroom and 3 bedroom residences
- Floors: mezzanine floors M1, M2 and M3–M6, and typical floors 2–35
- Typical floor (2–35) sizes: 2 bedroom units of 85–122 m² semi-gross (71–102 m² net); 3 bedroom units of 167–183 m² semi-gross (140–149 m² net)
- Show units: 2BC residence interior by Metaphor; 3BC residence interior by HBA

## Facilities

- Eluna facilities: Main Lobby, Lobby Lounge, Library, Private Dining, Pool Lounge, Function Hall, Play Area, Sky View Terrace, Zen Garden (Eluna Social Deck, 20th floor)
- Shared facilities: Lagoon Pool, Blue Lagoon, Cabana, BBQ Lawn, Kids Pool & Playground, Kids Room, Gym, Tennis Court, Jogging Track, Pet Park (P7A), Sunken Lounge
- Parking: condominium parking on P1–P6

## Nearby

- Transport: MRT and LRT (BNI City), Sudirman and Manggarai commuter line stations, Jakarta Inner Ring Road toll
- Malls: Mall Kota Kasablanka (directly connected), Kuningan City, Lotte Shopping Avenue, Pacific Place, Plaza Indonesia, Grand Indonesia, Plaza Senayan, Senayan City
- Schools: Kolese Kanisius, IISS, JIS Pattimura Elementary, Al-Azhar, Tarakanita, Santa Ursula
- Hospitals: MMC, Mayapada Hospital, RS Agung, Brawijaya Hospital, Tebet Hospital, Medistra, MRCCC Siloam
